script:
Look at those views! Austria has over 250 glaciers, including the Pasterze, the country’s largest.
Winters? Super snowy and perfect for skiing. Summers? Mild and sunny, prime picnic weather!

script:
Now for my favorite part: the Alps! These mega-mountains spread across the west, filled with ski slopes and cozy villages. 
It’s a winter wonderland!

script: What’s the capital of Austria? It’s Vienna, a city of grand palaces.

script: And the famous chocolate Sachertorte!

script:
German is the official language here! but many people also speak English. 
It’s a great place for making friends from all over!

visuals: Belvedere Palace gardens in Austria bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Austria’s population is around 9 million… that’s close to the population of New York City. Big enough for grand culture, but small enough for charm.

script: Hungry? Wiener Schnitzel is the national dish! breaded meat called veal, often served for special family meals. Yum!

script: Don’t forget Apple Strudel! It’s a sweet, flaky pastry filled with warm apples and whipped cream.

script: Thirsty? Sip some Almdudler! It’s a fizzy herbal soda that Austrians absolutely love.

visuals: Couples in formal attire dancing the Viennese waltz in a grand, chandelier-lit ballroom in Vienna, Austria. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Now let’s dance to the rhythm of tradition! The Viennese waltz twirls through grand ballrooms, and every New Year, Austria fills with elegant music during a giant televised concert. Fancy, right?

visuals: A soccer ball on a soccer field. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Ready for a throwback? In 1954, Austria took 3rd place in the World Cup! That’s a huge moment in their soccer history.

visuals: Austrian ski legend Marcel Hirscher mid-turn on a snowy race slope in the Alps. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Sports here? Alpine skiing rules the slopes! Legends like Marcel Hirscher, an 8-time World Cup champ.

visuals: A portrait of Arnold Schwarzenegger in his youth as a bodybuilder with an Austrian flag subtly in the background. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And Arnold Schwarzenegger! bodybuilder, movie star, and even California’s governor!

script: Still want more? Get this: during a festival called Almabtrieb, cows wear flower crowns as they stroll through villages after summer. Moo-velous fashion show!

script: Time to waltz away from this land of wonders and sweet treats! I’m leaving with a heart full of music and a belly full of strudel.
